{{Quote|Chewbacca suggests we show them our progress by destroying their listening array.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ChewieSuggests.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] belonging to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was '''attacked''' by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Shoran]]. The attack occurred during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for control of Alaris Prime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], during which the Trade Federation established the listening array to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the Wookiees. The array's [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[LUH-989]], had launched an unsuccessful [[attack on Chewbacca's camp]], after which Shoran's scouts found the listening array. Chewbacca and Shoran combined their forces in the attack, destroying the listening array's [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] and the defending [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Shoran's scouts have discovered an array of Trade Federation listening posts.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoransScouts.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was caught in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between its [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Trade Federation built a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] consisting of six [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] to monitor the Wookiees' progress, which was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LUH-989]]. A [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] belonging to the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was unsuccesfully [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attacked]] by LUH-989's forces.<ref name="GB" />

After the Wookiees defeated those droids, scouts from a [[Shoran's camp|camp]] run by another Wookiee [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]], [[Shoran]], discovered the listening array. Chewbacca suggested that the Wookiees destroy the array, a plan that was agreed upon by Shoran and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees. Chewbacca gathered<ref name="GB" /> a group of between eight and thirty Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> and marched through Shoran's camp to reach the listening array.<ref name="GB" />

==The attack==
[[File:Listening_array_fatality.png|thumb|right|250px|One of Shoran's troopers was killed at the listening array.]]
One of Shoran's heavy [[bowcaster trooper]]s attacked two of the [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] that lay on the other side of a [[Water/Legends|river]] before moving into the listening array. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] before Chewbacca's Wookiees and Shoran arrived at the array. They destroyed each of the transmitters there along with every battle droid, which included four [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, two advanced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], and two [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You've won the day again! Chewbacca's strategies are bearing fruit.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees after the attack|audio=VictoryArray.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Jinn congratulated Chewbacca for his successful strategies. After the attack, Chewbacca resolved to permanently expel the Trade Federation from Alaris Prime by destroying the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] at their main [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], which saw them removed from the moon.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chewbacca is dead! We cannot continue.|Qui-Gon Jinn if the player fails|audio=ChewieDead3.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alaris_Temple.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The player has access to Padawans they can use in the attack, including a young Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
The attack on the listening array was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima" />&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The attack is the final conflict of the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Allies and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]." The player is blocked from discovering the outpost earlier than intended by the walls of Shoran's camp, in which a gate appears after other story events have been completed. The player can use any military units available in the game's second [[technology level]] for the attack, which includes bowcaster troopers, [[dragon trooper]]s, [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|grenade troopers]], [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]], and Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], one of which is established to be Jinn's Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="GB" />

The strategy guide states that if the player has been consistently creating [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] prior to the attack, they should have between twenty and thirty Wookiees, but that only eight are necessary. The guide also stated that a scripted event of Shoran's forces fighting the Trade Federation would take place when the players units reach the listening array,<ref name="Prima" /> but this did not occur in the finished game. Instead, a single heavy bowcaster trooper from Shoran's camp attacks the sentry posts before moving into the base, followed by Shoran himself. If the player sends their Wookiees in too late, Shoran can be killed by the Trade Federation army, but unlike the deaths of other unique units in campaigns, including Chewbacca, this does not immediately end the level. Unused audio files from the level have Jinn inform the player that Shoran is assembling his forces to attack the array, and he suggests that the player send any newly created troops to join Shoran's forces.<ref name="GB" />
